# Which plates on your menu are actually carrying the place?

> Free menu engineering calculator for independent restaurants: enter each dish's plate food cost, menu price and units sold to classify it as a star, plowhorse, puzzle or dog, see contribution margin against the menu average, and size what a price move on the high-volume low-margin plates is worth a year.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
